title: A unified quantum computing quantum Monte Carlo framework through structured state preparation
summary: We extend Quantum Computing Quantum Monte Carlo (QCQMC) beyond ground-state energy estimation by systematically constructing the quantum circuits used for state preparation. Replacing the original Variational Quantum Eigensolver (VQE) prescription with task-adapted unitaries, we show that QCQMC can address excited-state spectra via Variational Fast Forwarding and the Variational Unitary Matrix Product Operator (VUMPO), combinatorial optimization via a symmetry-preserving VQE ansatz, and finite-temperature observables via Haar-random unitaries.
